claim: In the matching retail DLL, instance Player.EquipWeapon(Int32 widx) (0x06004EE0) has RVA 0x002E1AB0, exact 91-byte body SHA-256 f4436e9f21bb7d3b9eef160a5967c34e25eeaf52fcfcc87d41f6524ececa61eb, and exact control flow: if signed this.weaponIdx is not below raw 0, return; otherwise call WeaponMan.inst.GetWeaponObj(widx), return if the resulting Unity object is false, then write this.weaponIdx=widx, Weapon.State=raw 1, Weapon.PlIdx=this.PlIdx, and parent the Weapon transform to this Player transform. FACT-0015 FormAnimator.PlayAnimationSE contains one direct callvirt to EquipWeapon at IL+0x00E9. In verified R6 raw bytes, all 11 observed direct EquipWeapon children of PlayAnimationSE have parent PRE weaponIdx=-1, child PRE weaponIdx=-1, equal parent/child owner slots, child raw argument equal to child POST weaponIdx, and parent POST weaponIdx equal to that raw argument.
